# LetItBeMe — Complete Technical & Functional Specification

## Overview
LetItBeMe is an interactive real-time video broadcasting and live meeting commerce platform designed to replace legacy tools such as PXCH Corporate (`mypxch.com/pxchcorporate`), Zoom Webinars, Demio, Hopin, and Livestorm.

## Primary Architecture Modules

### 1. In-Stream 1-Click Commerce
- Built on top of tokenized Stripe Checkout Sessions.
- When an attendee clicks "Pay Now" or buys an offer during a stream, checkout occurs directly within the video canvas context without audio interruption or navigation away from the live meeting.
- Handles automated splits for ambassadors via Stripe Connect Express.

### 2. Interactive Presentation Layer
- **Live Whiteboard**: Native HTML5 Canvas with pen tool, multi-color palette, eraser, clear, and PNG export.
- **Synchronized Agenda & Checklist**: Real-time checklist synchronized across all devices via WebSockets and local storage.
- **Live Audience Polls**: Instant single-click voting with live percentage distribution bars.
- **Embedded Web Applications**: Sandboxed iframe embedding for tools like Cal.com, Figma, Google Slides, and custom SaaS dashboards.

### 3. AI Digital Twin & Multilingual Subtitles
- Audio-reactive digital twin presence when camera is toggled off.
- Real-time speech-to-text with translation into 9+ languages (EN, ES, FR, DE, JA, ZH, PT, AR, HI).

### 4. Ambassador Referral Engine
- Generates custom tracking links (`?ref=slug`).
- 30-day attribution window.
- Real-time GMV, clicks, conversions, and commission reporting.
- Direct Stripe Connect Express onboarding with automated month-end payouts.

## Comparison Table

| Feature | LetItBeMe | PXCH Corporate | Zoom Webinars | Demio / Livestorm |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-Stream 1-Click Checkout | Yes (Stripe Direct) | No (External Links) | No | No |
| Native Interactive Whiteboard | Yes (Zero Sign-up) | Partial (Complex) | Yes (Requires app) | No |
| AI Digital Twin Voice Avatar | Yes | No | No | No |
| Automated Affiliate Splits | Yes (Stripe Connect) | No | No | No |
| Live AI Multilingual Subtitles | Yes (9+ Languages) | No | Limited (Add-on) | No |
| No-Download Attendee Access | Yes (1-Click WebRTC) | Partial | No (Requires Client) | Yes |
